note: The statutory due-date register the Compliance Alerts screen runs, and the statutory HEADS the PF & ESI and TDS summaries read from closed payroll runs. Due days are DATA: a state that files PT on a different day, or a tenant with a different TDS cycle, changes this file and no code.
heads_note: employer_line_codes are the employer-contribution lines of the same head (PF & ESI Remittances: To be paid = employee + employer lines of the completed payroll). line_codes are the payslip line codes that count towards a head: the statutory engine writes the head itself (PF, ESI, PT, TDS) and a structure-level deduction may carry a component code such as D-PT. A tenant whose structure names its PT line differently adds the code here.

obligations.head: PF
obligations.label: PF ECR filing & remittance
obligations.blocks: PF remittance for the wage month; late payment attracts damages and interest

obligations.head: ESI
obligations.label: ESI contribution & return
obligations.blocks: ESI coverage of the insured persons for the month

obligations.head: PT
obligations.label: Professional tax remittance
obligations.blocks: the state PT return; the due day differs by state and is set here

obligations.head: TDS
obligations.label: TDS deposit (challan 281)
obligations.blocks: credit of tax deducted to the deductee; interest under 201(1A) from the day it is late

obligations.head: TDS
obligations.label: TDS return 24Q
obligations.blocks: Form 16 for every employee; late filing fee under 234E per day
